beats.desc: the man holds the new deadbolt latch with its dark faceplate and slides it into the mortise pocket on the white door edge, the bolt entering the door, his other hand bracing a blue-handled screwdriver
he presses the deadbolt latch faceplate flush into the door-edge mortise and steadies it with his fingers, the blue-handled screwdriver poised to drive the top mounting screw
beats.constraint: both hands stay at the door edge and the latch faceplate stays seated in the mortise.

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt installs the new deadbolt latch into the door edge with a blue-handled screwdriver, working with both hands; the man
scene_keep: the white door edge with two round bore holes on the door face and the mortise pocket cut into the edge, and the bright sunny window and porch with green foliage and a white railing behind
